DreamGaussian is a text-to-3D generation method that replaces the MipNeRF representation in the DreamFusion framework with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), using Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) loss to optimize 3D Gaussians [S1][S3, unofficial].

The claim states that DreamGaussian replaces MipNeRF with 3DGS in the DreamFusion framework and uses SDS loss to optimize 3D Gaussians. Both Source [S1] and Source [S3] explicitly confirm this exact mechanism in their passages regarding DreamGaussian. Therefore, every fact in the claim is supported by the evidence.
